details.description: Llama 3.2 1B is Meta's smallest pretrained base model in the Llama 3.2 family, released September 25, 2024 alongside a 3B sibling and instruction-tuned variants. This is the base checkpoint, not the instruction-tuned Llama 3.2 1B Instruct model, and is intended as a foundation for fine-tuning rather than direct chat use. Meta designed the 1B and 3B sizes to fit onto edge and mobile devices for on-device summarization, instruction following and rewriting once fine-tuned, keeping data local for privacy; its pretraining data has a cutoff of December 2023. On this catalog entry it has a 131,072-token context window.
advantages: Uses grouped-query attention (GQA) for improved inference efficiency, per Meta's model card.
Meta designed the 1B and 3B Llama 3.2 models to run on edge and mobile devices, enabling on-device agentic applications where data never leaves the device, per Meta's launch announcement.
Scores 96.8 (exact match) on a Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval test, per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: This is Meta's base pretrained checkpoint, not the instruction-tuned Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct model, so it is not fine-tuned to follow chat instructions directly.
Scores 32.2 on MMLU (5-shot) as the smallest model in the Llama 3.2 family, per Meta's model card.
Pretraining data cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's model card.
use_cases: Starting point for fine-tuning custom on-device or edge language models
Base checkpoint for summarization, instruction-following and rewriting models after fine-tuning
Continued pretraining or domain adaptation for lightweight, mobile-class models

sources.title: Llama 3.2: Revolutionizing edge AI and vision with open, customizable models

notes: The catalog's kind is 'chat' and facts show text_input/text_output with a 131,072-token window, matching Meta's stated 128K context for the Llama 3.2 1B/3B family and confirmed by Fireworks. This is nonetheless the base (non-instruct) checkpoint per both Meta's Hugging Face repo name and Fireworks' listing, which I called out as a disadvantage since it is not tuned to follow chat instructions the way Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct is. MMLU and ARC-Challenge numbers were cross-checked between Meta's Hugging Face card and its GitHub MODEL_CARD.md and matched exactly.
